transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, mostly it's my wife's idea. She, uh... she gets frustrated with me. She'll be telling me about things—like my cousin’s appointments, or sorting out his rides—and I’m looking right at her. But then a minute later I realize I didn’t actually take in half of what she just said. So... I guess that's what brought me in.
Did you have this same kind of trouble paying attention when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... even back in grade school, before I was 12, my teachers used to tell my parents I was daydreaming a lot. They'd say I was bright, but... I'd leave my homework in my desk. Or they'd have to keep reminding me to finish my classwork. So... yeah. It's been a long time, but I suppose I did.
Does this trouble paying attention cause problems for you at work?

Well... I'm not really working right now. I just do some small catering jobs here and there. But, um... yeah, I guess it does cause some issues. I have to double-check things a lot, or redo stuff so I don't mix up the orders. And like I said, it causes tension at home. My wife feels like she can't rely on me when it comes to helping out with my cousin. So... yeah. It's a problem.
Do you often act or speak before thinking?
No, not really. I'm... I don't think I do that. I usually just keep to myself.
Do you often find yourself worrying a lot about different things?
No... not really. I mean, I worry about the normal stuff, I guess. But... no more than anyone else.
Have your attention problems gotten noticeably worse in recent years?
Well... I suppose it's been more noticeable lately. Maybe... for the last 11 months or so. That's when my cousin moved in with us. He had surgery, so... things have just been harder since then.
Do you often forget things that were just told to you, even when you were trying to pay attention?

Yeah... I suppose so. That's actually kind of what brought me in, I guess. My wife will be telling me about my cousin’s appointments, or rides he needs... and I’m looking right at her. But... maybe a minute later, I realize I didn’t actually take in half of what she said.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I feel depressed. Just... tired, maybe. But not down.
Have you been having trouble with your memory for things that happened recently?
No... not that I've noticed. My memory seems fine. It's just... what I mentioned before. If I actually take it in, I remember it.
Do you have the same trouble paying attention in other situations too, not just when your wife is talking to you?

I suppose so. Yeah. Like... if I sit down to work out a catering order, or... I'm on one of those parish planning calls. I start off okay. But... before long, my mind just wanders off. I end up having to go back over the same notes, almost like I never read them in the first place.
Has anyone close to you said that your concentration has gotten worse compared with how you used to be?
No... I don't think so. Nobody's really said it's gotten worse, anyway. It just... seems about the same as it usually is.
Do you often lose things you need for daily tasks, like keys, papers, or your phone?

Yeah... I suppose I do. I'll just put my keys down, or... my phone. Catering receipts, maybe the garden clippers. Just somewhere in the house. And then... I end up spending ten minutes or so just retracing my steps to find them.
Do you often avoid or put off tasks that require a lot of sustained mental effort, like paperwork or detailed planning?
No... not really. I mean, if something needs getting done, I just do it. I don't think I really... avoid it or anything.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks or conversations?

Yeah... I guess so. If I sit down to work out a catering order, or... listen in on a parish planning call, I start off fine. But before long, my mind just sort of... wanders. I end up having to go back over the same notes, almost like I never read them in the first place.
Are you often easily distracted by things going on around you?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed that happening. It's usually fairly quiet around me anyway, so... no.
Do you often start tasks but have trouble finishing them?

I suppose so, yes. Sometimes I'll... I'll begin something simple, like setting up my cousin's pill organizer, or maybe cleaning off the prep table after cooking. And then, later on, I'll notice I left one or two steps unfinished. I just... don't quite get to the end of it, I guess.
Do you often fail to follow through on instructions or leave chores unfinished?
No, not really. I... I usually manage to get things done when I'm told to do them. I haven't noticed any real issues with that.
When you're reading something on your own, do you often find that your mind drifts and you have to reread the same passage?

I guess so. If I sit down to work out a catering order, or... listen through a parish planning call. I start off fine. But before long, my mind just wanders off. I end up having to go back over the same notes again, almost like I never read them.
